source.title: Where to Eat Korean BBQ and Samgyupsal in Seoul: 15 Authentic Local Favorites

hooks: Published Oct 16-17, 2026 with per-person budgets for each of the 15 spots (source article)
Mapo Jeong Daepo galmaegisal is cooked with an egg ring around the grill (source article)
Mongtan's straw-smoked u-dae galbi listed at 40,000-70,000 won pp (source article)

list.title: Korean BBQ in Seoul: Out of Town Blog's 13 spots
list.desc: Places from Out of Town Blog's 'Where to Eat Korean BBQ and Samgyupsal in Seoul: 15 Authentic Local Favorites' (https://outoftownblog.com/where-to-eat-korean-bbq-and-samgyupsal-in-seoul/). Collected by PinWith, not made by Out of Town Blog.

items.title: Geumdwaeji Sikdang (금돼지식당)
items.memo: Premium pork, known for nunkkot moksal; about 25,000-45,000 won pp.

items.title: Yukjeon Sikdang (육전식당)
items.memo: Thick-cut pork belly and pork neck, about 25,000-40,000 won pp.

items.title: Mapo Jeong Daepo (정대포)
items.memo: Galmaegisal skirt meat grilled with an egg ring around the pan.
items.check: article lists 52 Dohwa-gil; matched listing is in Dohwa-dong, same area

items.title: Cheongdonok (청돈옥)
items.memo: Aged pork including a tomahawk-style cut; English menu.

items.title: BBQ YUL Gangnam
items.memo: Aged pork grilled at the table; 30,000-50,000 won pp.

items.title: Sinmi Sikdang (신미식당)
items.memo: Chargrilled spicy pork ribs plus gamjatang in Apgujeong.

items.title: Mapo Sutbulgalbi (마포숯불갈비)
items.memo: Bone-in pork galbi in a large dining room, open very late.

items.title: Samgakjeong (삼각정)
items.memo: Mosori-sal and grilled pork skin; dinner-only hours.

items.title: Sammijung (삼미정)
items.memo: Samgyeopsal in Euljiro with indoor and outdoor alley seating.

items.title: Mongtan (몽탄)
items.memo: Straw-smoked u-dae galbi beef short rib, about 40,000-70,000 won pp.

items.title: Samwon Garden (삼원가든)
items.memo: Marinated and plain beef galbi; reservations advised for dinner.

items.title: Daechi Jeongyuk Sikdang (대치정육식당)
items.memo: Butcher-shop style beef inside ribs and pork cheek; few side dishes.

items.title: Hanok Grace (한옥그레이스)
items.memo: Pork and Korean beef platters served in a hanok; closed Sundays.

message.subject: I listed your Seoul Korean BBQ guide on one map
message.body:
Hi Melo, I'm Adrian from PinWith, a map-list app.

The egg ring around the galmaegisal at Mapo Jeong Daepo is such a good detail to point out. I put 13 of the places into one map: https://pinwith.me/@pinwith_en/outoftown-seoul-korean-bbq

It's private for now: only this link opens it, and I'll delete it if you'd rather I didn't.

With PinWith, your readers can follow in your footsteps: revisit the places you went or plan their own trip from one map, in their own language. That helps your content reach further.

If you like it, I'll move it to your account, credited to you, so you can link it in the post. Lists like this can also earn curators extra income: https://pinwith.me/for-creators?lang=en
No reply needed if it's not useful.

Adrian
